summary: Exascale Labs Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: XLAB/XLABW) filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing an October 8, 2026 purchase and sale agreement with Sunon Inc., a U.S. subsidiary of Taiwan-listed Sunonwealth (TWSE: 2421). Exascale will sell and deploy 12 NVIDIA HGX B300 GPU servers (96 GPUs) with networking, management servers, deployment and 36 months of IT operations at a U.S. data center for a total contract value of US$8,208,000, excluding duties and taxes. This is an ordinary commercial equipment/services contract, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply. Payment is 30% down within three days of purchase order, 70% within five business days of shipment-readiness notice; delivery depends on down payment receipt, chipmaker approval, and export/import authorizations. Watch execution and permit risk.
